roster.name: Chruna
roster.description: A human berserker in scale mail with a halberd, and a spare on her back.

sheet.stats: Human · STR 17 DEX 14 CON 14 · Speed 30 ft

features.name: Halberd
features.text: +5, 1d10+3 slashing. Heavy, reach 10 ft, two-handed. Mastery: Cleave.

features.name: Cleave
features.text: After a melee hit on her turn: one free attack on a second creature within 5 ft of the first and within reach, without her ability modifier on the damage. Once per turn.

features.name: Rage
features.text: Bonus action, three uses: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, +2 damage with Strength attacks, Advantage on Strength checks and saves, no spells. It lasts until the end of her next turn; attacking an enemy, or a bonus action, keeps it going. It ends if she is Incapacitated.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.text: Before her first attack roll on her turn: Advantage on Strength attack rolls until her next turn, but attack rolls against her have Advantage too.

features.name: Frenzy
features.text: Path of the Berserker: while raging and reckless, the first creature she hits with a Strength attack on her turn takes an extra 2d6.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.text: Advantage on Dexterity saves unless Incapacitated.

features.name: Savage Attacker
features.text: Once per turn, roll a weapon hit's damage dice twice and keep the higher total.

features.name: Alert
features.text: Add your proficiency bonus to initiative.

roster.name: Elion
roster.description: A human priest of life in heavy plate.

sheet.stats: Human · WIS 17 CON 16 · Spell save DC 13, attack +5 · Speed 30 ft

features.name: Warhammer
features.text: +4, 1d8+2 bludgeoning.

features.name: Divine Spark
features.text: Channel Divinity: a creature within 30 ft regains 1d8+3 HP, or makes a CON save against 1d8+3 radiant or necrotic damage (half on a success).

features.name: Turn Undead
features.text: Channel Divinity: each undead within 30 ft makes a WIS save or is Frightened and Incapacitated, and flees. Damage ends it.

features.name: Preserve Life
features.text: Channel Divinity: divide 15 HP among Bloodied allies within 30 ft, up to half their maximum.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.text: Healing spells cast with a slot heal an extra 2 + the slot level.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.text: Two uses.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.text: Cantrip. DEX save or 1d8 radiant. Ignores cover.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.text: Level 1. Ranged attack, 4d6 radiant; the next attack against the target has Advantage.

spells.name: Bless
spells.text: Level 1. Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attacks and saves. Concentration.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.text: Level 1. Touch: heal 2d8 + WIS.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.text: Level 1, bonus action. Heal 2d4 + WIS at range. One free cast.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.text: Level 1, bonus action. +2 AC. Concentration.

spells.name: Command
spells.text: Level 1. WIS save or the target falls Prone (Grovel).

spells.name: Protection from Evil and Good
spells.text: Level 1. Undead attack the target with Disadvantage. Uses the Holy Water flask.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.text: Level 1, bonus action. Attackers must save before targeting the warded creature.

spells.name: Aid
spells.text: Level 2. Up to three allies raise their maximum and current HP by 5.

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.text: Level 2, bonus action. End a condition.

spells.name: Spiritual Weapon
spells.text: Level 2, bonus action. A force weapon strikes (1d8 + WIS force); strike again each turn as a bonus action.

spells.name: Spare the Dying
spells.text: Cantrip. Stabilise a dying creature.

roster.name: Zombie 1
roster.description: A rotting corpse animated by necromancy that lurches toward the living.

features.name: Slam
features.text: +3, 1d8+1 bludgeoning.

features.name: Undead Fortitude
features.text: At 0 HP, a CON save (DC 5 + damage) leaves it on 1 HP. Radiant damage and critical hits bypass it.

roster.name: Mummy
roster.description: A desiccated undead in grave wrappings whose touch curses and whose glare terrifies.

features.name: Rotting Fist (x2)
features.text: +5, 1d10+3 bludgeoning plus 3d6 necrotic. The target is cursed: it cannot regain HP. A creature this attack drops to 0 HP dies.

features.name: Dreadful Glare
features.text: One creature within 60 ft makes a WIS save (DC 11) or is Frightened until the end of the mummy's next turn. On a success it is immune to this mummy's Glare.

features.name: Defenses
features.text: Vulnerable to fire. Immune to necrotic and poison. Speed 20 ft.

sheet.stats: Human · STR 17 DEX 14 CON 14 · Speed 30 ft

features.name: Halberd
features.text: +5, 1d10+3 slashing. Heavy, reach 10 ft, two-handed. Mastery: Cleave.

features.name: Cleave
features.text: After a melee hit on her turn: one free attack on a second creature within 5 ft of the first and within reach, without her ability modifier on the damage. Once per turn.

features.name: Rage
features.text: Bonus action, three uses: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, +2 damage with Strength attacks, Advantage on Strength checks and saves, no spells. It lasts until the end of her next turn; attacking an enemy, or a bonus action, keeps it going. It ends if she is Incapacitated.

features.name: Frenzy

features.name: Danger Sense
features.text: Advantage on Dexterity saves unless Incapacitated.

features.name: Savage Attacker
features.text: Once per turn, roll a weapon hit's damage dice twice and keep the higher total.

features.name: Alert
features.text: Add your proficiency bonus to initiative.

sheet.stats: Human · WIS 17 CON 16 · Spell save DC 13, attack +5 · Speed 30 ft

features.name: Warhammer
features.text: +4, 1d8+2 bludgeoning.

features.name: Divine Spark
features.text: Channel Divinity: a creature within 30 ft regains 1d8+3 HP, or makes a CON save against 1d8+3 radiant or necrotic damage (half on a success).

features.name: Turn Undead
features.text: Channel Divinity: each undead within 30 ft makes a WIS save or is Frightened and Incapacitated, and flees. Damage ends it.

features.name: Preserve Life
features.text: Channel Divinity: divide 15 HP among Bloodied allies within 30 ft, up to half their maximum.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.text: Healing spells cast with a slot heal an extra 2 + the slot level.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.text: Two uses.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.text: Cantrip. DEX save or 1d8 radiant. Ignores cover.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.text: Level 1. Ranged attack, 4d6 radiant; the next attack against the target has Advantage.

spells.name: Bless
spells.text: Level 1. Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attacks and saves. Concentration.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.text: Level 1. Touch: heal 2d8 + WIS.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.text: Level 1, bonus action. Heal 2d4 + WIS at range. One free cast.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.text: Level 1, bonus action. +2 AC. Concentration.

spells.name: Command
spells.text: Level 1. WIS save or the target falls Prone (Grovel).

spells.name: Protection from Evil and Good
spells.text: Level 1. Undead attack the target with Disadvantage. Uses the Holy Water flask.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.text: Level 1, bonus action. Attackers must save before targeting the warded creature.

spells.name: Aid
spells.text: Level 2. Up to three allies raise their maximum and current HP by 5.

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.text: Level 2, bonus action. End a condition.

spells.name: Spiritual Weapon
spells.text: Level 2, bonus action. A force weapon strikes (1d8 + WIS force); strike again each turn as a bonus action.

spells.name: Spare the Dying
spells.text: Cantrip. Stabilise a dying creature.

features.name: Slam

roster.name: Mummy

features.name: Rotting Fist (x2)
features.text: +5, 1d10+3 bludgeoning plus 3d6 necrotic. The target is cursed: it cannot regain HP. A creature this attack drops to 0 HP dies.

features.name: Defenses
features.text: Vulnerable to fire. Immune to necrotic and poison. Speed 20 ft.

features.name: Halberd

features.name: Cleave
features.text: After a melee hit on her turn: one free attack on a second creature within 5 ft of the first and within reach, without her ability modifier on the damage. Once per turn.

features.name: Rage
features.text: Bonus action, three uses: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, +2 damage with Strength attacks, Advantage on Strength checks and saves, no spells. features.name: Frenzy

features.name: Danger Sense
features.text: Advantage on Dexterity saves unless Incapacitated.

features.name: Savage Attacker
features.text: Once per turn, roll a weapon hit's damage dice twice and keep the higher total.

features.name: Alert
features.text: Add your proficiency bonus to initiative.
